title: Wayfaring Stranger
artist: American Traditional · Guitar Tab Studio 初学编配

provenance.arrangementCredit: Guitar Tab Studio melody with documented alternating-bass accompaniment
provenance.recordingCredit: Guitar Tab Studio deterministic guitar recording and local synthetic guide vocal
provenance.note: Two public-domain verses and repeated refrains are synchronized to the melody; every audible guitar event is included in the TAB. The vocal is a synthetic guide, not a human performance.

measures.lyric: I am a poor wayfaring stranger
While journeying through this world of woe
Yet there's no sickness, toil, or danger
In that bright world to which I go
I'm going there to see my father
I'm going there no more to roam
I know dark clouds will gather round me
I know my way is rough and steep
Yet brighter fields lie just before me
Where God's redeemed their vigils keep
I'm going there to see my mother
She said she'd meet me when I come
